messages.content: What is the effect of economic status on happiness levels?

function.name: get_happiness_index
function.description: Fetches the happiness index for a given country or area based on data compiled from global surveys. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which to retrieve the happiness index.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the happiness index.

demographic_group.description: The demographic group for which to retrieve the happiness index. If not specified, the total for all groups will be returned.

But we need to specify country, year, and demographic group. The question is general: effect of economic status on happiness levels. We could provide a general explanation, citing data. But maybe we can give a general answer referencing World Happiness Report. We can mention that high-income groups tend to have higher happiness scores than low-income groups. Provide some numbers. We could use the function to fetch data for a particular country, e.g., United States, 2022, for each income group. That would illustrate effect. Let's do that. Use get_happiness_index with country="United States", year=2022, demographic_group="high income", "middle income", "low income". Then we can compare. We'll call function thrice.
